name: Demon Dogs
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
If you are going to remain here, I ask only that you earn your keep. We have many nuisances that could use some 'discipline.'

You can start with the Plaguehounds and their runts.

I cannot offer much in return, but you are guaranteed a warm meal and some conversation should you succeed.
narrative.objectives: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer. Come. Rest. Let us eat and talk of days long past!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do not pity the demon dogs, friend. They are abominations!

chain.subtitle: 9 quests from level 56 to 60, 52,875 XP in all.

quests.name: Demon Dogs
quests.objectiveText: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.objectiveText: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer.

quests.name: Of Lost Honor
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objectiveText: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands.

quests.name: Find Myranda
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion.

quests.name: In Dreams
quests.objectiveText: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
